_meta: Starting subclass builds seeded from general knowledge as of early 2026. VERIFY against the current season — supers, aspects, fragments and exotics get retuned often. Every field is editable in-app.

Titan|Solar.fragments: Ember of Torches, Ember of Empyrean, Ember of Searing, Ember of Solace
Titan|Solar.exoticArmor: Loreley Splendor Helm (or Pyrogale Gauntlets for Maul)
Titan|Solar.weapons: Solar primary with Incandescent; strong special + heavy for DPS
Titan|Solar.playstyle: Sunspot uptime for healing + Throwing Hammer loop for ad-clear and survivability.

Titan|Arc.fragments: Spark of Resistance, Spark of Shock, Spark of Brilliance, Spark of Frequency
Titan|Arc.exoticArmor: Cuirass of the Falling Star (Thundercrash DPS)
Titan|Arc.weapons: Arc weapons w/ Voltshot/Jolting Feedback for amplified ad-clear
Titan|Arc.playstyle: Stay amplified via melee/Knockout; Thundercrash for boss burst with Cuirass.

Titan|Void.fragments: Echo of Persistence, Echo of Exchange, Echo of Expulsion, Echo of Undermining
Titan|Void.exoticArmor: Doom Fang Pauldron or Ursa Furiosa
Titan|Void.weapons: Void weapons w/ Repulsor Brace + Destabilizing Rounds for overshield loop
Titan|Void.playstyle: Overshield uptime + volatile rounds; team buff with Bubble/Bastion.

Titan|Stasis.fragments: Whisper of Rime, Whisper of Chains, Whisper of Fissures, Whisper of Shards
Titan|Stasis.weapons: Stasis weapons w/ Headstone / Chill Clip for freeze synergy
Titan|Stasis.playstyle: Freeze and shatter for crowd control; stack frost armor for survivability.

Titan|Strand.fragments: Thread of Warding, Thread of Generation, Thread of Ascent, Thread of Continuity
Titan|Strand.weapons: Any; lean melee — a strong add-clear primary + DPS heavy
Titan|Strand.playstyle: Banner of War healing/damage loop; sustain through melee and Tangle pickups.

Titan|Prismatic.fragments: Facet of Protection, Facet of Courage, Facet of Purpose, Facet of Dominance
Titan|Prismatic.weapons: Whatever fuels Transcendence (mix of Light/Dark damage)
Titan|Prismatic.playstyle: Build Transcendence; suspend + consecration-style melee burst. (Prismatic shifts often — verify.)

Hunter|Solar.fragments: Ember of Torches, Ember of Empyrean, Ember of Searing, Ember of Solace
Hunter|Solar.weapons: Solar w/ Incandescent; precision for Celestial GG burst
Hunter|Solar.playstyle: Cure/restore on dodge; Celestial Nighthawk for big single-target burst.

Hunter|Arc.fragments: Spark of Resistance, Spark of Shock, Spark of Ions, Spark of Frequency
Hunter|Arc.weapons: Arc w/ Voltshot/Jolting Feedback to amplify and jolt
Hunter|Arc.playstyle: Combination Blow melee loop with Liar's; stay amplified for resist + speed.

Hunter|Void.fragments: Echo of Persistence, Echo of Obscurity, Echo of Expulsion, Echo of Cessation
Hunter|Void.weapons: Void w/ Repulsor Brace + Destabilizing Rounds
Hunter|Void.playstyle: Invis → Gyrfalcon volatile rounds; tether for debuff and add control.

Hunter|Stasis.fragments: Whisper of Rime, Whisper of Chains, Whisper of Fissures, Whisper of Torment
Hunter|Stasis.weapons: Stasis w/ Chill Clip / Headstone for freeze + shatter
Hunter|Stasis.playstyle: Duskfield control with Renewal Grasps; freeze and shatter clusters.

Hunter|Strand.fragments: Thread of Warding, Thread of Generation, Thread of Ascent, Thread of Transmutation
Hunter|Strand.exoticArmor: Gyrfalcon's? No — Cyrtarachne's Facade (grapple woven mail)
Hunter|Strand.playstyle: Grapple aggressively with Cyrtarachne woven mail for survivability; suspend with tangles.

Hunter|Prismatic.fragments: Facet of Protection, Facet of Courage, Facet of Purpose, Facet of Dawn
Hunter|Prismatic.playstyle: Invis + melee loop, build Transcendence for big damage windows. (Verify current Prismatic meta.)

Warlock|Solar.super: Well of Radiance (or Song of Flame on Prismatic)
Warlock|Solar.fragments: Ember of Torches, Ember of Empyrean, Ember of Searing, Ember of Solace
Warlock|Solar.exoticArmor: Sunbracers (grenade spam) or Speaker's Sight (healing turret)
Warlock|Solar.weapons: Solar w/ Incandescent for scorch chains
Warlock|Solar.playstyle: Well of Radiance team buff; Sunbracers grenade spam for ad-clear.

Warlock|Arc.fragments: Spark of Resistance, Spark of Shock, Spark of Ions, Spark of Frequency
Warlock|Arc.exoticArmor: Geomag Stabilizers (Chaos Reach) or Crown of Tempests
Warlock|Arc.playstyle: Ionic traces for ability uptime; Chaos Reach for sustained boss damage.

Warlock|Void.aspects: Feed the Void (Chaos Accelerant or Child of the Old Gods)
Warlock|Void.fragments: Echo of Persistence, Echo of Exchange, Echo of Undermining, Echo of Expulsion
Warlock|Void.exoticArmor: Nezarec's Sin (ability regen) or Contraverse Hold
Warlock|Void.weapons: Void w/ Destabilizing Rounds + Repulsor Brace
Warlock|Void.playstyle: Devour loop for survivability; volatile/weaken for damage and control.

Warlock|Stasis.fragments: Whisper of Rime, Whisper of Chains, Whisper of Fissures, Whisper of Shards
Warlock|Stasis.playstyle: Bleak Watcher turret + coldsnap chains for permanent freeze lockdown.

Warlock|Strand.fragments: Thread of Warding, Thread of Generation, Thread of Ascent, Thread of Rebirth
Warlock|Strand.weapons: Hatchling weapons amplify the threadling swarm
Warlock|Strand.playstyle: Threadling swarm via Weaver's Call + Swarmers; constant ad-clear.

Warlock|Prismatic.fragments: Facet of Protection, Facet of Courage, Facet of Purpose, Facet of Balance
Warlock|Prismatic.exoticArmor: Spirit of the Necrotic / Getaway Artist
Warlock|Prismatic.playstyle: Summon Hellion + turret; build Transcendence. (Prismatic retunes often — verify.)
